title: SoRoMoX: Fast, Differentiable, and Parallelizable Soft Robot Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.06650v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reduced-order models based on Cosserat-rod theory are now well established, and modeling theory is no longer the primary bottleneck in soft-robot control. Their implementations, however, do not support the differentiable, GPU-parallel, and control-oriented workflows that underpin advanced rigid-robotics applications. Here, we fill this gap with SoRoMoX (Soft Robot Models in JAX), a fully numerical, JIT-compilable Python/JAX framework. SoRoMoX implements articulated, Piecewise Constant Strain, and Variable Strain models through a unified, control-ready interface that provides inertia matrices, gravitational and elastic forces, Jacobians, and their derivatives. To our knowledge, it is the first rod/strain-based soft-robot modeling framework that runs directly on GPUs, with Warp kernels accelerating parallel continuum-model execution, and is end-to-end differentiable with respect to states, inputs, and parameters. translated_title: SoRoMoX：快速、可微分且可并行的软体机器人模型
translated_abstract: 基于Cosserat杆理论的降阶模型如今已发展成熟，建模理论不再是软体机器人控制的主要瓶颈。然而，现有实现并不支持可微分、GPU并行以及面向控制的工作流程，而这些正是先进刚性机器人应用得以实现的基础。本文提出SoRoMoX（基于JAX的软体机器人模型）来填补这一空白，它是一个完全数值化、支持JIT编译的Python/JAX框架。SoRoMoX通过统一的、面向控制的接口实现了铰接模型、分段常应变模型和变应变模型，该接口可提供惯性矩阵、重力与弹性力、雅可比矩阵及其导数。据我们所知，这是首个可直接在GPU上运行的基于杆/应变理论的软体机器人建模框架，借助Warp内核加速并行连续体模型的执行，并且对状态、输入和参数均支持端到端可微分。
tldr: SoRoMoX是首个基于JAX的软体机器人建模框架，可直接在GPU上运行、端到端可微分且支持并行加速，通过统一接口为软体机器人控制提供了多种应变模型。
en_tdlr: SoRoMoX is the first rod/strain-based soft-robot modeling framework in Python/JAX that runs directly on GPUs with end-to-end differentiability, providing a unified control-ready interface for soft robot control.
